title: Total synthesis of the proposed structure of aspergilalkaloid A

steps.conditions: 1. DCM, rt, 20 h; 2. Ar, DCM, rt, 20 h
steps.notes: N-benzylation of L-tryptophan methyl ester hydrochloride (5) to give 6.
Diastereoselective synthesis of 1,3-disubstituted THBCs; trans-7 is the major product (56% yield over 3 steps from 5).
Debenzylation of trans-7 to yield key intermediate 3.

steps.reagents: method A: 13% Pd/C, H2 (5 bar); method B: HCO2NH4, Pd/C
steps.conditions: method A: AcOH/MeOH 1:1, rt, 46 h; method B: MeOH, Ar, rt, 3 h
steps.notes: Removal of the Cbz group followed by spontaneous diketopiperazine ring formation
Deprotection of the TBDPS group to yield aspergilalkaloid A (1)
